titulo: Choosing which side to stand on
resumen: Rahab hid the spies and misled the king of Jericho's men. An honest letter about the courage to choose which side to stand on.

versos.texto: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.
About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

reflexion: Yesterday the king demanded that Rahab hand over her guests. Today we hear what she did. Before answering, Rahab had already hidden the two men. Then she spoke to the king's messengers: she told them the men had already left when it got dark.

But the men were still hidden in her house. Rahab did not tell the truth. The Bible tells what she did without dressing it up. Christians have talked a great deal about that lie. What the story does make clear is which side she chose to stand on.

Rahab took a risk to protect two foreigners who were wanted by the king of her city. Maybe today you too have to decide which side you are on, even if it costs you. God doesn't ask you to have everything figured out. He invites you to take a step of trust and to seek paths of truth. He sees your hard decisions and walks with you through them.
dedicatoria: This letter is for you, who have a hard decision to make today. God walks with you.
oracion: Lord, give us courage to protect those in danger and to choose your way. Guide us with your truth in every hard decision. In Jesus' name, amen.
